reviews.title: Drive is compatibile with Xbox 360 using FATXplorer!
reviews.comment: Used this 512gb drive in my Xbox 360 as it is one of the few SSDs that you can flash the firmware on to make the 360 think it to be a genuine Xbox drive.  It works well, despite being choked off a bit with the older SATA 2 interface of the Xbox 360.  Use FATXplorer to flash and stage the drive, buy a 3D printed drive shell to fit into the bay on the side of the later model 360s.  Slap the drive in and off you go!  Took about an hour for the work and anyone competent enough to swap out PC drives and hardware will have zero issues doing this.  Well worth it!!
reviews.author: S. H. Mellish

reviews.title: It works and does the job. Love the price
reviews.comment: Someone gave me a computer that was not working. In there frustration they reenacted the seen from Donkey Kong when the gorilla would throw the barrels. The guy was about 290lbs. Strong guy. The DVD drive was moving by itself and making strange noises. The HDD was D.O.A. I had gotten this sold stat drive just to try it out on a different system. It was so cheap I thought why not. It was only $12.74 on sale. I don’t need a lost of space so I just went with the 128GB. And wouldn’t you know it. It worked. All I had to do was reinstall Windows 10. The install even picked up the Windows key on the motherboard. Say what you want to about Acer computers but that can taking a beating.
